tools.name: ecommerce-catalog_product-normalize
tools.description: Read a brainiac-catalog-v1 or Google Merchant subset feed and standardize sku, title, category, price, availability, and GTIN. A dollar sign is not treated as USD, and missing materials or dimensions are not filled in. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/ecommerce-catalog/product-normalize. An unpaid cal

tools.name: ecommerce-catalog_product-attribute-extract
tools.description: Read structured attribute pairs and lines labeled Attribute: name | value. Unlabeled description prose is not turned into a specification. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/ecommerce-catalog/product-attribute-extract. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: ecommerce-catalog_product-variant-validate
tools.description: Group products by the supplied parent sku and flag repeated color and size pairs, price disagreements, and parents that are not in the request. Missing options are not invented. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/ecommerce-catalog/product-variant-validate. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms a

tools.name: ecommerce-catalog_product-description-quality-check
tools.description: Flag missing, placeholder, HTML, and very short descriptions. When minLength is omitted, descriptions shorter than 40 characters are flagged. No description text is generated. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/ecommerce-catalog/product-description-quality-check. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment

tools.name: ecommerce-catalog_product-category-classify
tools.description: Match a supplied category to the caller taxonomy, or mark one keyword match as inferred. Several matches are a conflict, and no category is chosen or invented. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/ecommerce-catalog/product-category-classify. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: ecommerce-catalog_product-feed-validate
tools.description: Check brainiac-catalog-v1 or the documented Google Merchant subset, plus any required fields and types in the caller schema. Unknown columns are ignored. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/ecommerce-catalog/product-feed-validate. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: ecommerce-catalog_product-image-metadata-audit
tools.description: Check supplied image URLs, alt text, filename extensions, and supplied pixel sizes. Image files are not downloaded and alt text is not generated. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/ecommerce-catalog/product-image-metadata-audit. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: ecommerce-catalog_product-health-report
tools.description: Combine the normalize, attribute, variant, description, category, feed, and image checks. The report does not approve the catalog for a sales channel. Price $0.12 USDC. POST /api/v1/ecommerce-catalog/product-health-report. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "ecommerce-catalog" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: ecommerce-catalog_product-normalize, ecommerce-catalog_product-attribute-extract, ecommerce-catalog_product-description-quality-check, ecommerce-catalog_product-feed-validate, ecommerce-catalog_product-image-metadata-audit · Private data: ecommerce-catalog_product-image-metadata-audit · Public sink: ecommerce-catalog_product-normalize, ecommerce-catalog_product-attribute-extract, ecommerce-catalog_product-variant-validate, ecommerce-catalog_product-description-quality-check, ecommerce-catalog_product-category-classify, ecommerce-catalog_product-feed-validate, ecommerce-catalog_product-image-metadata-audit, ecommerce-catalog_product-health-report · Destructive: ecommerce-catalog_product-normalize, ecommerce-catalog_product-attribute-extract, ecommerce-catalog_product-variant-validate, ecommerce-catalog_product-description-quality-check, ecommerce-catalog_product-category-classify, ecommerce-catalog_product-feed-validate, ecommerce-catalog_product-image-metadata-audit, ecommerce-catalog_product-health-report.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
